question: Does Wulfgar of Icewind Dale's last ability make its own melee ability trigger an additional time?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: Wulfgar's last ability causes its melee ability to trigger an additional time.
expected.answer: Wulfgar's last ability will cause its melee ability to trigger an additional time.
